rules: Only dev basins / dev stations / dev reservoirs may be used to calibrate, gate or choose anything in Phase 2.
Exam units are for final reporting only. Their streamflow (any period) is never a training target.

Gauged exam protocol: an exam basin may use its own observed Q from the calibration period as model INPUT or for per-basin classical calibration; it is scored in the validation (and recent) periods only.

Ungauged exam protocol: no streamflow from the scored basin in any period. Donor information may come only from dev basins (protocol U-dev, same information an ML model gets) or, for the literature-style regionalisation baseline, from other folds of ungauged_folds_k12 (protocol U-k12).

Simulated training may use real forcing of ANY basin from non-exam periods (before 1989-10-01, 1999-10-01..2015-09-30), and real attributes only from dev basins (and from regions/datasets not used in any exam).
Sections of this file are frozen when written; later runs only add new sections.

calibration.note: CAMELS standard protocol (Newman et al. 2017; Kratzert et al. 2019): train/calibrate

validation.note: CAMELS standard test period: the main temporal exam

recent_exam.note: water years 2016-2023; Q from USGS NWIS (beyond Caravan end 2014); forcing ERA5-Land from Caravan ends 2023-12-30; NWM retrospective v3.0 ends 2023-01-31 (NWM scores use WY2016-2022)

temporal.water_year: Oct 1 - Sep 30, named by the ending year

camels_us.eligibility: daily Q coverage >= 90% in both CAMELS periods (Caravan record) and |area(Caravan) - area(NWIS)| < 10%
camels_us.stratification: per HUC2 region n = max(1, round(50 * N_region / 671)); within the region the eligible basins are sorted by snow class (frac_snow <0.1, 0.1-0.3, >=0.3) then aridity rank and picked by systematic sampling with a seeded random start; then 3 extra regulated basins (reg_class mid/high, distinct HUC2) are added at random.

reservoirs.rule: core = ResOpsUS dams with >= 10 years of simultaneous storage, inflow and release and a GRanD/ResOpsUS capacity; dev = per (main use in fcon/irri/elec/supp/other) x (capacity above/below median) cell, n = max(1, round(14 * N_cell / N_core)) at random (seed+3); exam = rest of core; aux = everything else (incomplete variables; free for simulator calibration of single processes, never scored).
reservoirs.temporal: each exam reservoir: first half of its simultaneous record (>= 1980) = calibration of rule curve/demand, second half = scored. Dev reservoirs: free.

snotel.rule: eligible = >= 10 complete water years; dev pool = eligible stations whose HUC8 contains no EXAM CAMELS-US gauge; per state n = max(1, round(40 * N_state / N_eligible)), systematic sample by elevation with a seeded start (seed+2); exam = all other eligible stations.
snotel.temporal: classical per-station calibration WY2001-2010, scoring WY2011-2025; networks may use dev stations fully

camelsgb.rule: one basin per aridity tercile (FAO-PM aridity), first in a seeded permutation (seed+1+region index) with >= 80% daily Q coverage 1990-2009

camelscl.rule: one basin per aridity tercile (FAO-PM aridity), first in a seeded permutation (seed+1+region index) with >= 80% daily Q coverage 1990-2009
